relationship: For a fixed reference angle, resizing a right triangle changes side lengths but preserves the appropriate sine, cosine or tangent ratio.

learnerLoop.action: Choose the reference angle, resize the triangle and select or calculate the needed ratio.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The triangle dimensions and side-role labels update while the angle remains fixed.
learnerLoop.evidence: The glidepath construction, ratio display and checked working show invariant side proportions.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose the ratio that connects the known side to the required side.

invariants: Corresponding side ratios for a fixed angle remain unchanged under resizing.
Side roles are defined relative to the selected reference angle.
safeAdaptations: Vary fixed angles, target sides and solvable right triangles.
Adjust working support while retaining interactive resizing and side-role evidence.
nonGoals: Choosing a trigonometric ratio from absolute side position rather than reference-angle roles.
